test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Cornelius said to Pauline, “This house has been far too large for me since the death of my wife.”

options.text: Cornelius said to Pauline that this house has been far too large for me since the death of my wife.
Cornelius told Pauline that that house had been far too large for him since the death of his wife.
Cornelius told Pauline that that house had been far too large for me since the death of my wife.
Cornelius asked Pauline if that house has been far too large for him since the death of his wife.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Cornelius told Pauline that that house had been far too large for him since the death of his wife.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Present Perfect Continuous Tense.
 
• Present Perfect Continuous Tense changes to Past Perfect Continuous Tense.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed in **told, ****ask**ed, demanded, ordered, enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Remove the commas and inverted commas.
 
• The first person in reported speech changes according to the subject of reporting speech.
 
• Use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
 
• Example: *Isha said, “Kavya has been crying for 2 hours .”** *(Direct speech)

 * Isha said that the Kavya had been crying for 2 hours.* (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Cornelius told Pauline that that house had been far too large for him since the death of his wife.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• If the sentence of Direct speech has a question that cannot be answered by saying yes or no then it does not use “if” or “whether” in its Indirect speech.

 
 
• Example: * **She said to me, “Where did you buy this dress from?” *(Direct speech)

 * **She asked me where I had bought that dress from. *(Indirect speech)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• Direct Speech को Indirect Speech में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Perfect Continuous Tense में है।
 
• Present Perfect Continuous Tense, Past Perfect Continuous Tense में बदल जाता है।
 
• Said/said to रिपोर्टिंग verb वाक्य की प्रकृति के अनुसार asked, demanded, ordered, enquired में बदल जाती है।
 
• Commas और inverted commas हटा दे।
 
• Reported speech में first person, reporting speech के subject के अनुसार बदलता है।
 
• Indirect speech के वाक्य में that का प्रयोग करें।
 
 
• Example: *Isha said, “Kavya has been crying for 2 hours .”** *(Direct speech)

 * Isha said that the Kavya had been crying for 2 hours.* (Indirect speech)
